name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost) as soft matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', since key_lost already requires the door to be shut and so needs no Precedence. The hard Existence(target_picked_up) matches the commanded box pickup. The hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) matches 'open the door, then', and with the hard Existence it forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed.

texts: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed: a key drop with the door shut (key_lost) should be avoided, as a preference.
Pick up the box in the other room, the mission target, as a required goal.
Open the door before picking up the box in the other room: the box pickup must not happen before the door is open.
